title: Map the three proven switch_pt forms to the accepted Engine child

replaces_attempt.reason: Its declared Engine parent was the rejected switch_pt/v1 foundation. This revision consumes only the accepted Layer-7e and dispatch children.

evidence.fact: All 17 measured members have the sole miss shape verb_unmapped:switch_pt; the only proven forms are self, target creature, and each creature.
The parser already emits switch_pt atoms with object self, target creature, or each creature structure; this ticket must not alter parsing.
map_atom currently has no switch_pt branch. The neighboring map dispatch is the only allowed implementation seam.

The accepted Engine child consumes switch_pt with no target for self, a bare creature target for target creature, and value.target=each for each creature. It provides UntilEOT cleanup and must not be reimplemented here.

required_behavior: For activated or triggered self forms, map to ('switch_pt', {}, None). Do not map a targetless spell source.
For a bare target creature form, map to ('switch_pt', {}, {'filter': 'creature'}). Preserve the existing target pipeline; do not add target qualifiers.
For each creature, map to ('switch_pt', {'target': 'each'}, None), which means every creature under the accepted Engine child.
Target player, a qualified target, and 'each creature on the battlefield' remain unmapped; they are outside the measured three-form contract.
Add focused direct map_atom tests for the three positives and an adjacent target-player negative.
gates: git status --porcelain adds or changes only scripts/paragraph/reparse.py and scripts/paragraph/test_switch_pt.py
python3 /opt/development/magic-ops/scripts/factory-ng-targeted-demand.py verb_unmapped:switch_pt reports zero members after the candidate Map patch

execution.selection_reason: This is an evidence-complete, two-file Map wiring change with one exact representation per known scope; it is the intended low-cost Qwen prepared-direct class.

on_failure: Record an immutable receipt. Do not change parsing, Engine code, or corpus data; any broader grammar is a separate ticket.
